text_block_list.text:
A promotional video shoot for the Satono 
Resort was scheduled on a deserted island, 
and I came along to help out.
The title of the video was simply—

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
"If you could bring just one item to a 
deserted island?" —Now, what will your 
choice be, Vivlos-san?

True to the title, various items had been 
prepared. Everything from practical 
survival tools to novelty variety goods.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Heeey☆ Here's what I chose! A "Tropical 
Drink"♪
choice_data_list: (...A tropical drink?)

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Oh...? Are you quite sure about that? 
There are many practical items available, 
though...
choice_data_list: （……トロピカルドリンク？）
choice_data_list_en: ï¼â¦â¦A tropical drink?ï¼

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Yep, this is totally fine! Because Papa 
always told me!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Whenever you have the chance to enjoy 
yourself, enjoy it to the fullest! That's 
how life becomes truly fulfilling"—he 
said!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
So even on a deserted island, I'm gonna 
get into the resort mood with a tropical 
drink and have a blast~☆
choice_data_list: (I see...)

text_block_list.text:
While it would probably be a terrible 
choice on a real deserted island, today 
was just a shoot for a few hours. The 
recording went smoothly without a hitch.
choice_data_list: （なるほど……）
choice_data_list_en: (I see...)

text_block_list.text: Or so we thought—

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat...!? The boat back can't move 
because of engine trouble!?
choice_data_list: (What!?)

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
Yes, a replacement boat has been 
dispatched to pick us up, so please wait a 
little while...!
choice_data_list_en: (Huh?!)

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Hey, isn't this turning into a huge 
deal...? A-Are we gonna be okay~...?
choice_data_list:
Yeah... I think we'll be fine once the 
replacement boat arrives.

Yeah... I think we'll be fine once the 
replacement boat arrives.

text_block_list.text:
And so we ended up waiting for the 
replacement boat, but as time passed, the 
sun grew even hotter—
choice_data_list: ああ……代わりの船が来れば大丈夫だと思う
うん……代わりの船が来れば大丈夫だと思う
choice_data_list_en: Yeah... I think we'll be fine once the replacement ship arrives.
Yeah... I think we'll be fine once the replacement ship gets here.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: So hot~~... I'm gonna melt~~~...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
And my tropical drink is all gone too... 
What do I dooo~~...

Under this blazing sun and heat, 
heatstroke was just around the corner. 
...At this rate, we're in trouble.
choice_data_list:
(Alright, let's borrow some props from the 
shoot...!)

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Wah... A parasol!? You went and got one 
for me!?
choice_data_list: （よし、撮影用の道具を借りよう……！）
choice_data_list_en: (Alright, let's borrow some filming equipment...!)

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much~~...! ...Haaa~~. The 
shade feels so nice~...
choice_data_list: 熱中症になったらまずいからね
choice_data_list_en: It'd be bad if you got heatstroke.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: KYAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAH!!!!
choice_data_list: Whoa...! What happened!?
Whoa...! What happened!?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
B-B-B-Bug! A buuug...!! It's squiggly and 
has weird colors...!!
choice_data_list: うわぁ……！どうした！？
うわぁ……！どうしたの！？
choice_data_list_en: Whoa...! What happened?!
Whoa...! What's wrong?!

text_block_list.text:
Finding bug spray among the survival 
props, I successfully repelled the oddly 
colored bug—!
choice_data_list: わ、わかった、退治するから落ち着いて！
choice_data_list_en: A-All right, I'll get rid of it, so calm down!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Y-You saved meee~... Uuu, that color and 
weird wriggling... I hope it doesn't show 
up in my dreams~...!

Handling the various troubles unique to a 
deserted island took time, and soon the 
sun began to set.

It would be dangerous once it got dark and 
we couldn't see our footing, so I decided 
to borrow a lantern and light it.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: The lantern is so cute~!
choice_data_list:
It's going to get dark, so watch your 
step.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Okay! —You know, thank you soooo much for 
everything today!
choice_data_list: 暗くなるから足元に気をつけてね
choice_data_list_en: It's getting dark, so watch your step, okay?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I caused so much trouble, didn't I? 
...Actually, I was kind of regretting it.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Picking a tropical drink first thing might 
have been the wrong move after all~...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Like, if I had chosen a tent, maybe I 
could have managed on my own, right?
choice_data_list: Well... maybe so.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
All the things you did for me, I bet 
Onee-chan usually does that kind of stuff 
for me all the time.
choice_data_list: それはまあ……そうかも
choice_data_list_en: Well... maybe so.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I was having fun, Onee-chan was 
always having a tough time behind the 
scenes, wasn't she~...
choice_data_list:
We shouldn't forget to be grateful from 
now on.

We shouldn't forget to be grateful from 
now on.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Next time, I'm gonna try helping out 
too!
choice_data_list: これからは感謝を忘れないようにしないとな
これからは感謝を忘れないようにしないとね
choice_data_list_en: I'll make sure never to forget my gratitude from now on.
I'll make sure never to forget my gratitude from now on.

text_block_list.text:
Vivlos has an honest and pure-hearted 
personality. Perhaps thanks to this 
unusual experience, she seemed to gain a 
lot of new insights.
choice_data_list:
I hope you always treasure that innocence 
of yours.

I hope you always treasure that innocence 
of yours.
You've really grown up.

text_block_list.text:
Vivlos has an honest and pure-hearted 
personality. Perhaps thanks to this 
unusual experience, she seemed to gain a 
lot of new insights.
choice_data_list: 君のその純真さは今後も大切にしてほしい
貴方のその純真さは今後も大切にしてほしい
ちょっと大人になったね
choice_data_list_en: I want you to hold onto that innocence of yours.
I hope you'll always cherish that innocence of yours.
You've grown up a bit, haven't you?

text_block_list.text:
While paying attention to practical 
matters is important, her innocence is 
also a precious strength. I told her that 
she should treasure it.
choice_data_list: 君のその純真さは今後も大切にしてほしい
貴方のその純真さは今後も大切にしてほしい
ちょっと大人になったね
choice_data_list_en: I want you to hold onto that innocence of yours.
I hope you'll always cherish that innocence of yours.
You've grown up a bit, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Eh? Really?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... I see~! Yeah, maybe so!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Onee-chan often praises me saying "Vivlos 
is so honest", too! I'll make sure to 
cherish this properly☆

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Right~? Maybe from now on, I'll lean 
harder and harder into adult charm♪

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Now that that's settled, I'll do my best 
helping pack up to head back!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
First is cleaning up the trash! If there 
are any empty drink cups, I'll collect 
them all~!
